description.text: Teaching Objectives The joint MBA Program between Ningbo University( MBU) and the University of Canberra( UC) was started in 2001 upon the approval of the Ministry of Education of China. It is the only Chinese-foreign joint MBA program in Zhejiang Province, China. Up to now, more than 369 advanced managerial professionals have graduated from this program. The program is now positively recognized in China and abroad Main Courses Financial Management Marketing Economics and Policy Entrepreneurship Business Finance International Trade Law BGL Research Project Fee RMB 100,000 of tuition and RMB 3,000 of textbook fee for 2 years totally Duration 2 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted MBA by UC Extra Service Students are encouraged to attend Chinese language courses at NBU for free when studying MBA courses

duration.text: The Sino-Australia Joint MBA Program at Ningbo University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 13888 USD/In total ￥ 100000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7.Proof of work experience (if applicable)

requirements.text: 1. Related Bachelor degree holders with no work experience 2. Unrelated Bachelor degree holders with three-year's work experience 3. A related graduate cert/ diploma and no work experience 4. Advanced Diploma holders( 3 years full-time, related undergraduate study) with a minimum of 4-year work experience 5. Other applicants are to be assessed on a case-by-case basis 6. IELTS 6.0 cross all levels or equivalent before the start of the program 7. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport and in good health;
